profile.headline: User-Focused Full Stack Developer with advanced skills in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer with a B.S. in Chemical Engineering, 3+ years of consulting experience, and will soon earn a Professional Studies Certificate in Full Stack Web Development. Proficient in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and the MERN stack.  Learning new concepts has always excited me and even led me to create my own course. Lauded by many as being a phenomenal communicator due to high levels of engagement, responsiveness, and clarity in my speech. Assisted in hundreds of engineering projects, and saved numerous engineering hours due to my problem solving skills. I am a person that finds fulfillment in helping others and improving the quality of life of everyone I interact with.

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
•  Collaborated with a team of 10 to provide critically acclaimed support to 500+ companies.
Advised up to 25 clients weekly and expedited their projects to forge positive relationships.

• Generated $200,000+ in new license sales and secured countless renewals through exceeding client expectations on project quality and delivery time. 

• Educated 200+ clients yearly in training courses and recognized by company president, manager, and hundreds of attendee reviews for phenomenal technical communication skills.

• Mentored new hires by providing educational lessons on engineering concepts, client interactions, and technical troubleshooting.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
• Coached and developed problem-solving skills in math, chemistry, and physics amongst my peers and other engineering students.  
• Developed the ability to communicate and lead students with diverse backgrounds. 
• Tutored up to 20 students per week.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:

projects.title: Excella
projects.description:
Excella is a web application that contains multiple productivity applications. The live version of Excella includes a Job CRM and Eisenhower Matrix. Soon Excella will include a Pomodoro Timer along with additional modules that are under development! The end goal of these modules is not only to excel at productive tasks or work habits, but promote the development of a more organized and efficient work flow. This which will in turn allow you for more time for recreation and things you find fulfilling. Therefore, you could say Excella is here to help you excel.

Read more about this project on Github: https://github.com/AshisPatel/excella

projects.title: Shop-Shop
projects.description:
Shop Shop is an example of an ecommerce webpage built using the MERN stack. Additional technologies include using Redux to manage the global state of the frontend and uses GraphQL to manage requests to the server's database. Furthermore, Shop Shop utilizes the Stripe API in test mode to simulate the process of checking out.

Read more about the project on Github: https://github.com/AshisPatel/shop-shop-redux
